nameEn: Manufacture of magnetic and optical media
description: This class includes the manufacture of magnetic and optical recording media.
includes: manufacture of blank magnetic tapes: audio, video, computer data
manufacture of magnetic discs and diskettes
manufacture of blank optical discs: CDs, DVDs, Blu-ray discs
manufacture of smart cards with magnetic strips
manufacture of flash memory cards and USB flash drives
excludes: manufacture of computers and peripherals, see 2620
